name: OpenVibe.Shared

exposure.note: also served at /shared/* by each site

conditions: manual: consumers pin release tags; going back means pinning the previous tag in package.json and redeploying the consumer
rollback.window: any time; a published tag is never moved or deleted
blockers: a consumer that already uses an API added in the newer tag must drop that use first

contracts.none: no manifest range: it pins openvibe-contracts v0.52.0 in package.json

notes: Versioned UI, chrome, SEO, legal and release-client packages every OpenVibe site renders (openvibe-shared). A released library, not a runtime: tagged releases installed from https://codeload.github.com/OpenVibers/OpenVibe.Shared/tar.gz/refs/tags/<tag> (v1.3.0 on 2026-09-23) and served at /shared/* by each site. Nothing to deploy or poll.
